channel.title: Blog UNNIVAI
channel.description: Guides and itineraries for travelling in Italy through real places: what to do when it rains, walking routes and travel with artificial intelligence.

item.title: What to eat in Naples, in the order of the day
item.description: Sfogliatella, fried pizza, pizza a portafoglio, cuoppo, babà and STG pizza: what to eat in Naples and when, with indicative prices and where sources disagree.

item.title: Visiting Matera's Sassi: how to see them and when to go
item.description: The Sassi of Matera on foot in one day: a route through Sasso Barisano and Caveoso, the Casa Grotta, how to get there and when to go, with official sources.

item.title: Palermo street food guide: markets, hours and what to order
item.description: Capo, Ballarò and Vucciria in Palermo: when to go, what to order (panelle, arancina, sfincione, pani ca meusa) and what it costs, with sources that disagree.

item.title: Milan in a weekend when it rains: a Plan B itinerary
item.description: Two rainy days in Milan: the Duomo, Galleria, Museo del Novecento, Castello Sforzesco, Brera and the Last Supper, with hours, indicative prices and closures.

item.title: Cinque Terre on foot: trails, trains and what is closed
item.description: Walking the Cinque Terre in late October 2026: which trails show as closed, what the Trekking Card and trains cost, the Via dell'Amore and rail works.

item.title: What to eat in Catania: 10 tastes in order of the day
item.description: Arancino, granita with brioche, pasta alla Norma, horse meat and Sant'Agata sweets: what to order in Catania, when, and roughly what it costs.

item.title: Venice without the crowds: when to go and where to eat
item.description: How to visit Venice without the crowds: the access fee, vaporetto fares, Rialto market hours and bacari, with the sources' disagreements flagged.

item.title: One day in Lecce: baroque, pasticciotto and walking lanes
item.description: A walking itinerary for one day in Lecce: Roman amphitheatre, Duomo, Santa Croce, the castle and a pasticciotto, with hours and prices from official sources.

item.title: Florence in 48 hours without pointless queues
item.description: Two days in Florence in a sensible order: Duomo and Dome, Accademia, Uffizi. Hours, closing days, prices and bookings read on the official sites.

item.title: Catania fish market: hours, what to see and how to visit
item.description: Indicative hours, when to go, what to look at and what to avoid at the Catania fish market, a few steps from Piazza Duomo.

item.title: What to do in Catania when it rains: 7 indoor ideas
item.description: Rain in Catania? Seven places under a roof, a sensible order to see them and how to rewrite your day without wasting the afternoon.

item.title: Rome in two days: an itinerary that does not wear you out
item.description: Two days in Rome in a sensible order: stops grouped by area, hours to check and how not to spend the day in a queue.

item.title: One day in Ortigia: a walking itinerary, without rushing
item.description: How to see Ortigia in a day: order of the stops, where to slow down and what to leave out so it does not turn into a marathon.

item.title: AI travel itineraries: what works and what does not
item.description: How to use AI to plan a trip without letting it invent places that do not exist: what to ask, what to check and why real places matter.
